dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a teardrop-shaped profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white across the entire visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Absent, with the exception of a single localized dark longitudinal streak on the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp contrast at the blowhole; diffuse gradient at the boundaries of the posterior dark streak.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single dark elliptical opening (blowhole) at the anterior end and a distinct, dark linear streak along the posterior central axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Shadow-casting longitudinal indentation along the central dorsal axis coinciding with the location of the dark posterior streak.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear mark/streak along the posterior dorsal ridge.
